sentences.text: The allegation leveled against the applicants are that co-accused Karan who is son of the present applicants, committed rape upon the prosecutrix on false promise of marriage and extracted the money from the account of the complainant and when the prosecutrix went to house of the co-accused Karan and told the applicants (parents) about the conduct of their son, they started to abuse her and denied to return the money.
Learned
counsel for the applicants submits that they are innocent and they have been falsely implicated in this case.
The main allegation levelled against co-accused Karan.

It is further argued that as per bank statement, money transactions in favour of the present applicants are not there;
therefore, prima facie there is no evidence against the present applicants.
It is further argued that present applicants abused and threatened the prosecutrix in the month of Feburary, 2023, however,
an FIR
was lodged on 28.5.2023 after delay of almost two months for which no plausible explanation has been given.
The applicants are old persons and they have no criminal history.

It is further submitted that the applicants are ready and willing to co-operate in the investigation and shall abide by all the terms and conditions as may be imposed by this Court; therefore, he prays for grant of anticipatory bail.
On the other hand, learned counsel for State has opposed the prayer and prayed for its rejection.
Heard learned counsel for the rival parties and perused the case diary available on record.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and material available on record, but without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, this application is allowed and it is directed that in the event of arrest, the applicants be released on bail, on executing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/-(Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with a solvent surety in the like amount each to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer/Investigating Authority.
The applicants shall further abide by other conditions enumerated under Section 438 (2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
Certified copy as per rules.

(SUNITA YADAV) JUDGE Ahmad Prem Singh Kushwah vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/111133486/
